blockers: constenv_2var_determines (NfComposition.lean:298): On Fin.cons x (fun _ => t) envs, depth-k 2-var NF agreement implies depth-k (n+1)-var NF agreement. Requires induction on k. The quantifier step after nf_extend_fwd produces an env [y,x,t,...,t] with a 3-var non-constant prefix — the IH needs to handle arbitrary prefix widths, suggesting a generalized padding approach.

constenv_nvar_to_2var (NfComposition.lean:321): Reverse: (n+2)-var NF agreement implies 2-var NF agreement on constenvs. Should follow from iterating nf_drop_last with the constenv projection identity (Fin.cons x (fun _ => t)) ∘ castSucc = Fin.cons x (fun _ => t) at smaller arity.
KampBypass.lean:356,368 (Until/Since backward k>0): Core sorry requiring Prior composition theorem or enriched formula per plan v5.
